name: antaris-guard
description: Antaris-Guard as a Claude Code plugin: a fail-closed command guard for coding agents. Two editions of the same code; install antaris-guard unless you are Antaris Analytics.

plugins.name: antaris-guard
plugins.description: The Bash guard and the subagent guard. Each repository's .claude/guard.config.json decides; where there is none, the built-in defaults do.

plugins.name: antaris-guard-antaris-analytics
plugins.description: Antaris Analytics' own edition of the same guard: where a repository has no config, configs/antaris-analytics.json decides instead of the generic defaults. Everyone else should install antaris-guard.
